findings.summary: TestEntryReportCallerRace and TestEntryFormatterRace start goroutines without a WaitGroup, so tests may finish before the race occurs and pass even with the fix reverted.
Formatting now runs inside the Logger.mu critical section, so slow formatters serialize concurrent logging, and a formatter that logs through the same logger would deadlock.
Copy-pasted comment in TestEntryFormatterRace says 'before SetReportCaller' while the call is SetFormatter.
